title: Grid V1 Mechanics and Dimensions
context: To establish a definitive ranked candidate for flicking (Grid), we must strictly define the bounds, target sizes, overlap rules, and limits.
decision: Grid will run for 60 seconds. Targets have a radius of 50000 (fixed units). Maximum 3 targets on screen. Overlap is permitted but exact position must be deterministically seeded via PRNG.
consequences: Clients must support a 60-second fixed timeline.
Score coefficients will assume 50000 radius targets.
